title: Openness of bounded local fibre dimension on the source
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $s\in S$ let $X_s$ be its scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. For $x\in X$, let $\widetilde x$ be the unique point of $X_{f(x)}$ mapping to $x$ under its projection to $X$, and let $\dim_{\widetilde x}X_{f(x)}$ be the topological dimension at that point [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], namely the minimum of the Krull dimensions of its open neighbourhoods in the fibre. For every integer $n\geq0$, the subset $$U_n=\{x\in X\mid\dim_{\widetilde x}X_{f(x)}\leq n\}$$ is open in $X$. No properness, quasi-compactness, Noetherian, finite-presentation, or flatness hypothesis is assumed.
